title: The open restriction, extension and tensor-section interface
statement: On a small site (C,J), for a sheaf A of sets, commutative ring sheaves R,S and a:R→S, define a_A by precomposing a with the element projection. Define restriction L_R and extension I_R as the element-site module pullback and extension of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-sheaf-slice-adjunction]. Their normalized adjunction is the actual sheaf pullback/pushforward adjunction. For a prescribed scalar model E of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], tensorSection(m,s) is the image of s tensor m under the module-sheafification unit and the prescribed equality of E with scalar extension. extensionSection(m) is the actual I_R ⊣ L_R unit evaluated at (U,f).
